l.i: rarent. Opto ego potius ut liberet vos Deus optimus maximus ex illorum faucibus, & regnum vestrum sartum tectum conseruet, ut olim Danielem seruum suum in Leonum spelunca saluum & incolumem conseruauit. Vobisque robur & consilium in regni vestri administratione suggerat, & sua per Christum misericordia com-plectatur.

page.notes: The page is a fragment: it begins mid-sentence ("rarent."). The faint lower text is show-through from the reverse and was omitted. The 's' long s is rendered as s. The 'spelunca' abbreviation mark over the u is read as a tilde (spelūca in the scan) and is simplified to spelunca.
